policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would define the refunded portion of certain refundable Federal income tax credits as a "Federal public benefit."
policy_week.effect: If you are an alien who is not a "qualified alien", you would be ineligible to receive the refunded portion of certain refundable Federal income tax credits.

tech.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is rolling out new AI-enhanced software as part of an $875 million initiative to improve the management of the nation's airspace.

Vivo has launched its new X500 Pro Max phone in China, featuring advanced photography capabilities including 17 stops of dynamic range and 4K240 slow-motion video recording, powered by new Sony and MediaTek sensors and silicon.

Apple is paying $250 million to settle claims that it failed to deliver an AI-upgraded Siri, with eligible iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 owners in the US now able to submit claims for a payout.

world.summary: China's Communist Party has expelled two top military leaders, citing corruption and disloyalty, as part of an ongoing anti-corruption crackdown within the armed forces.
Seven Ethiopian rebel groups, who have been active for years in the country's most populous regions, have announced the formation of a new alliance to work together.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed that the state of the world is deteriorating, attributing this decline to the paralysis of the UN Security Council.
The first charges in the United Kingdom related to the 1994 Rwanda genocide have been brought, with Dr. Vincent Brown, 65, set to appear in court on Tuesday facing seven offenses.

us.summary: Diesel prices in the United States have reached record highs, now exceeding $6.50 a gallon, a development that is expected to lead to higher prices for various goods and is deepening a farm crisis during harvest season.
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is preparing to implement AI-enhanced software as part of an $875 million modernization effort to manage the nation's airspace.
A federal immigration agent shot and injured a man during an operation in Austin, Texas, with the Department of Homeland Security now leading the investigation into the incident.

science.summary: New research on ancient human remains suggests habitual usage of betel nuts, a plant seed with mind-altering properties that remains popular in parts of Asia despite associated health risks.
Poison is suspected in the deaths of ten lions found inside Tanzania's Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve, raising concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.
